tasks.label: proxyenv: frontend dev
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $reuse=$false; try { $response=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:1420' -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 2; $reuse=$response.Content -match 'src/main.ts' } catch { $reuse=$false }; if ($reuse) { Write-Output 'VITE v7.3.6 ready in 0 ms (reusing existing ProxyEnv server)'; exit 0 }; & 'D:\nodejs\corepack.cmd' pnpm dev; exit $LASTEXITCODE

tasks.label: proxyenv: stop stale debug instance
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $debugExe=[System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath('${workspaceFolder}\.cargo-target\debug\proxyenv.exe'); $instances=@(Get-Process -Name proxyenv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($_.Path) -eq $debugExe }); if ($instances.Count -gt 0) { $instances | Stop-Process -Force -ErrorAction Stop; $deadline=[DateTime]::UtcNow.AddSeconds(5); do { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 100; $remaining=@(Get-Process -Name proxyenv -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.Path -and [System.IO.Path]::GetFullPath($_.Path) -eq $debugExe }) } while ($remaining.Count -gt 0 -and [DateTime]::UtcNow -lt $deadline); if ($remaining.Count -gt 0) { throw 'The previous ProxyEnv debug process is still running.' } }

tasks.label: proxyenv: rust debug build
args: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $debugTemp='${workspaceFolder}\.debug-tmp'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $debugTemp | Out-Null; $env:TEMP=$debugTemp; $env:TMP=$debugTemp; Import-Module 'D:\VisualStudio\BuildTools\Common7\Tools\Microsoft.VisualStudio.DevShell.dll'; Enter-VsDevShell -VsInstallPath 'D:\VisualStudio\BuildTools' -SkipAutomaticLocation -DevCmdArguments '-arch=x64 -host_arch=x64'; $env:CARGO_HOME='D:\Rust\cargo'; $env:RUSTUP_HOME='D:\Rust\rustup'; $env:Path='D:\Rust\cargo\bin;' + $env:Path; & 'D:\Rust\cargo\bin\cargo.exe' build --manifest-path '${workspaceFolder}\src-tauri\Cargo.toml' --target-dir '${workspaceFolder}\.cargo-target'; exit $LASTEXITCODE
